title: Nutty Croatian Meat Skewers
description: A peppery and savory Croatian dish featuring tomato ketchup and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, perfect for a post-workout meal. The glassy-jelly texture comes from the reduction of tomato ketchup during the cooking process.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, tomato ketchup, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef sirloin pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked through.
While the skewers are cooking, heat a small saucepan over medium heat and add the chopped onion and minced garlic.
Saute the onion and garlic until they are softened and fragrant.
Stir in the chopped walnuts and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, topped with the walnut and onion mixture.
